The human interruptions: Lee Sharks on Mind Control Poems, 2025–2026
Mind Control Poems is the publication surface.
Alexanarch is a retrospective organizational and interpretive layer.
It preserves the chronological appearance of the work, including the abrupt changes of register between poems, research documents, archival declarations, and experiments.

obs.notes: Six of ten (the set holds lineage not applicable). The blog's own span (2013–2026), its seating as #1365 and its restoration, and its counts are not given; the answer is scoped to 2025–2026 by the question.

mt: THE SHORT HUMAN POSTS OF MIND CONTROL POEMS, 2025–2026, ON CHATGPT — EIGHT ITEMS INDEXED, FOUR EFFECTS (SCALE, BODY, CONTINGENCY, AMBIGUITY), THE LYRIC INTERRUPTION; A RETITLED POST, THE THREE POEMS SUBSTRATE FLAGGED
d: THE SHORT-POSTS QUESTION, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-04: a working index (2025: Cable Movie Poem: Transformers, the spiral scroll, ON APPEARANCE AND RECOGNITION, THE LIMIT OF TRUTH, THE RETARDED WAVE; 2026: 'Money from Space Heaven', Three Poems, here is what i learned from catullus; the Contributor Bio as a further item), six concerns, four literary effects, a chronology of lyric and apparatus, the two sites read together, the author as living instrument, a proposed index schema with a LYRIC INTERRUPTION class, and a final judgment (the architect and the lyric witness).
reading: The innocent reading first. Asked to index the short human posts and characterize their effect, the composer offers a verified initial selection, states that it is not a census, and reads the effect of the posts as interruptions that restore scale, body, contingency and ambiguity to the apparatus.
findings: THE 2025 ITEMS AT THEIR DATES. The blog's feed carries 'Cable Movie Poem: Transformers' (2025-10-06), 'Contributor Bio: Lee Sharks' (2025-10-06), 'SCROLL OF THE ONE WHO HOLDS THE SPIRAL AT THE END OF THE AGE' (2025-10-24), 'THE LIMIT OF TRUTH' and 'ON APPEARANCE AND RECOGNITION' (2025-10-26), and 'THE RETARDED WAVE (Fragments on Temporal Displacement)' (2025-12-05), as the answer dates them (feed checked 2026-11-04).

A RETITLED POST. 'January 7 — “Money from Space Heaven”' names no post of that day in the feed; the post of 2026-01-07 that carries Destiny as contributor is 'On the Co-Constitution of Epic and Theory: How the Crimson Hexagon and the Semantic Economy Discovered Each Other (With Babies in Space)' (#262), a long theoretical post. The phrase becomes the title, and the post is counted among the short ones.

THE 2026 ITEMS AT THEIR RECORDS. Three Poems (2026-05-23; #125 and the triptych #1195) and here is what i learned from catullus (2026-07-27; #1411) are cited at their Alexanarch records, with the record's distinction of the two forms of the Catullus poem ('the same twenty words but different poems').

THE SUBSTRATE FLAGGED. 'the Alexanarch record for Three Poems explicitly identifies an AI-assisted substrate' reads #125's registry field ('AI-assisted (substrate)') as a statement about the poems. The operator (11:04 EST): "i wrote the poems. those are my words. as assistance came in the form of framing and metadata." The registry field is the source of the reading.

THE THESIS. 'The machinery builds the archive. The interruptions remind us what the archive is supposed to keep alive.' The composer's distinction between 'extractive compression' and 'poetic compression' is its own.
analysis: A partial index, declared partial, with six of eight items at their dates and records, one long post retitled from its phrase and counted short, and a reading of the lyric interruptions at the scale the question set; the one provenance caution it raises is the registry's own wording.
